network_state: Three regional contract areas and two town networks

Krnovsko (licences 852xxx), Bruntálsko (853xxx) and Rýmařovsko (854xxx), the Krnov town lines (856xxx) and the two Bruntál town loops (855xxx), all Transdev Morava, branch Bruntál. Lines running into the Olomouc region (913 and 921 to Olomouc, 922 to Uničov, 912 to Šternberk) are modelled to their ends: in this data no other line serves their stops there.
Diversion timetables to the timetable change or beyond

The CIS JŘ export has diversion versions valid on the vehicle day for 824 (to 12 Dec), 880 (20 Jul – 14 Dec), 901 and 907 (29 Sep – 19 Dec) and 861 (12 Oct – 20 Dec). They run to the end of the timetable year or past it, so they are modelled as they run.

876 (to 23 Oct), 912 (15 – 21 Oct) and 921 (to 23 Oct) ran diversion timetables on the vehicle day that end within days, so their regular timetables are modelled (shared rule: short works as the regular state). 912 regular adds Jiříkov, Těchanov; 921 regular runs its Břidličná local trips to Huzová.

260 Opava – Horní Benešov – Bruntál and 920 Opava – Bruntál – Rýmařov hold a licence here and one in Opavsko (902260: 28 trips, 902920: 34 trips on the day, against 3 and 14 here). They are modelled once, on the Opavsko/Vítkovsko/Hlučínsko sheet.
The export already holds a new version of 909 valid from 22 Oct 2026, two days after the vehicle day; the sheet keeps the version of the vehicle day.

texts.lede_who: The ODIS bus lines of three regional contract areas around Krnov, Bruntál and Rýmařov (Krnovsko, Bruntálsko, Rýmařovsko) and the town lines of Krnov and Bruntál, all run by Transdev Morava from its Bruntál branch
texts.swap_places: Krnov, Bruntál, Rýmařov and Moravský Beroun
texts.scope: Transdev Morava licences with the area prefixes 852 (Krnovsko), 853 (Bruntálsko), 854 (Rýmařovsko), 856 (MHD Krnov) and 855 (MHD Bruntál)
texts.scope_check: The prefixes match the live map (Transdev Morava, pr. Bruntál) and the fleet numbers: 82- buses run 852, 83- run 853, 84- run 854 and 81- are the Krnov town buses. 260 and 920 also hold Opavsko licences and are on that sheet.
texts.buses_extra: The fleet is the seznam-autobusu register of Transdev Morava (01c_fleet.py); every bus seen on these licences is in it.
texts.depots: Transdev Morava, branch Bruntál (with its Krnov and Rýmařov outstations). A seen bus counts at the branch the live map reports for it; a designed bus at its home branch.
texts.unmodelled_intro: Sparse lines whose stops other lines already serve (method Step 8: a long-interval line only where it is a place’s only service) and lines with no afternoon trips.

pak.why: Regional buses take VZ-ODIS-bus; Transdev Morava's white with the red Transdev logo and the kraj logo is the transdev livery. Krnov's town buses take the town package VZ-MHDKrnov-bus (krnovbila). A regional bus lent to a town line keeps its VZ-ODIS-bus object. The pak fleet desk confirmed every object on 21 Oct 2026 (transdev is Transdev Morava's white with the red Transdev figure and the kraj ring; krnovbila is the Krnov white with blue-yellow chevrons); nothing new is needed.
